topic: Kuttanad rice farming below sea level
hook: Your rice field in Kuttanad sits below sea level.
title: Your Kerala Rice Field Is Below Sea Level
description:
Kuttanad in Kerala is a region where farmers grow rice on land below sea level. They hold back the water with earth walls called bunds. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.
